properties.notes: Potential opportunity for redevelopment of functioning bus garage, embedded within the urban environment. Currently in use and occupied but could become available in future. However this will be dependent on the operational needs of Go North East and options for relocation and therefore it is not considered to be immediately available for redevelopment. Opportunity to link with adjacent land as part of a wider redevelopment scheme (sites 2628 and 9136). Identified as an allocation in the draft Local Plan (submitted May 2019) and also reflected in the emerging draft Hexham Neighbourhood Plan.
properties.ownership-status: not owned by a public authority
